topics.topic: TrialExecution provenance and actor attribution for manual versus admission trials

What fact distinguishes an agent-requested trial execution from a kernel-run admission execution, including which agent requested the former?

questions: Does `issued_by` name the requesting agent or the kernel that minted the version, and where is the other actor recorded?

topics.topic: Actor identity resolution when configured token values collide
questions: What happens if the same token value is configured for the owner and an agent, or for two differently named agents, when one request must mint exactly one Actor identity?

topics.topic: Effect of trial-corpus growth on existing contract activation
questions: After the corpus grows, is the existing activation still usable by new runs, automatically re-admitted, or unusable until its implementation is submitted and admitted over the new corpus?

topics.topic: Eligibility and data retention for capturing failed executions
questions: Can a failed function execution be captured after its run ends `refused` or `cancelled`, particularly when its inputs included files whose bytes have already been removed?

topics.topic: Identity and reuse semantics for repeated AdmissionVerdicts
questions: When admission is repeated for the same implementation and unchanged corpus, is the prior AdmissionVerdict reused, is a new verdict entity created, or is the deterministic verdict value separate from the newly created execution evidence?

topics.topic: Installation identity and audit history after token-list changes
questions: Does a token-list change replace the Installation with a new configuration value, or mutate one continuing installation entity, and is that change represented anywhere in kernel records?

topics.topic: MCP operation boundaries and agent authority to request activation
questions: Which distinct MCP operations exist, which primary actions are folded into `author` or another operation, and may an agent request activation of a proven read-only flow?

topics.topic: Recovery semantics for running runs, nodes, and effect attempts after restart
questions: After restart, what happens to a run persisted as `running`, including nodes with no concluded NodeExecution and any persisted `in_flight` EffectAttempt?

topics.topic: Scope and input source of a try-implementation action
questions: Does one try action execute the implementation against every case in the current corpus, one selected existing case, or request-supplied ad hoc inputs?

topics.topic: TrialCase and file-fixture disclosure to repairing agents
questions: What parts of TrialCases, including file fixtures, are returned to a repairing agent or through inspection, and how does disclosure class affect that read?

topics.topic: Whether agents may submit actual personal-data values
questions: May an agent submit an actual personal_data value as a run input, flow constant, or authored trial-case value, or must such value-bearing actions be owner-only?
